items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: this was when I met -- let's see, Tyree was living at Ms. Waters' apartment, you know, Tyree Glenn, that is

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. And, this was when I met -- let's see, Tyree was living at Ms. Waters' apartment, you

know, Tyree Glenn, that is, and Don Byas was, but I went there and met Freddie Green, and that's -- at that time, Les Paul, I think it was -- Les? Yeah, I think it was Les ... he was big in radio in New York, I think. I'm sure it was Les Paul, because he would come to the jam sessions someplace down in Morningside; a place they used to go down under, almost underground, and that was the first time that I went there, and Jimmy Mundy was getting ready to form a band, also.

items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I know that Callender Eddie Barefield did it

ctx.x: No. But I mean everybody in town

that could play at all, you know. I'm sure ... I know that Tyree did it, I know that Don Basas did it, and I know that Callender Eddie Barefield did it; I know Red Calendar did, because Red Callender Calendar is a very good tuba player, you know, and he was in it every year. And as you said, Marshall was in it, Marvin Johnson ...
Do you have a drum strapped on?
